# pve_sdn_subnet (Resource)

Manages an SDN subnet object nested under a vnet (`/cluster/sdn/vnets/{vnet}/subnets`). Changes stay pending until the `pve_sdn_apply` action runs.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.
# A subnet tracks the IP space of a vnet. Run the `pve_sdn_apply` action
# afterwards to activate pending SDN changes.

resource "pve_sdn_subnet" "subnet1" {
  vnet       = "vnet1"
  subnet     = "10.0.0.0-24"
  gateway    = "10.0.0.1"
  snat       = true
  dhcp_range = ["10.0.0.100-10.0.0.200"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `subnet` (String) The subnet identifier in CIDR form; PVE writes the mask separator as a hyphen (for example `10.0.0.0-24` for `10.0.0.0/24`). Changing this value forces recreation.
- `vnet` (String) The vnet this subnet belongs to. Changing this value forces recreation.

### Optional

- `dhcp_dns_server` (String) IP address of the DHCP DNS server.
- `dhcp_range` (List of String) DHCP ranges for this subnet, each written as `start-end` (for example `10.0.0.100-10.0.0.200`).
- `dnszoneprefix` (String) DNS domain zone prefix; with prefix `adm`, hostnames register as `<hostname>.adm.mydomain.com`.
- `gateway` (String) Subnet gateway, assigned on the vnet for layer3 zones.
- `snat` (Boolean) Enable masquerade for this subnet when the pve-firewall is used.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.
# Import an existing SDN subnet by `<vnet>:<subnet>`:
terraform import pve_sdn_subnet.subnet1 vnet1:10.0.0.0-24
```
